name: Homepage shows a hero heading at the top and the bracket section below
description: When a visitor opens the homepage, the top 600 pixels surface a hero region containing a heading or large title element, scrolling down reveals the knockout bracket section, the overall page is not a blank white viewport, and any hero background image or photo has actually rendered rather than showing a broken-image placeholder.

planSteps.description: Inspect the hero region inside the top 600 pixels of the viewport

Verify the hero region in the top 600 pixels surfaces a heading or large title element rather than blank space, and that any hero background image or photo has actually loaded (visible rendered pixels, not a broken-image placeholder or empty box)
Scroll down the page until the knockout bracket section enters the viewport
Verify the bracket section is visible in the viewport after scrolling and the page background is not a pure white blank surface
